summary: Add a shared Effect optimistic-mutation primitive for web clients

replay.detail: Pending mutations are in-memory client overlays; no claims or replay behavior change.

schema.detail: No wire or storage schema changes.

rules.detail: Server authority and action admission remain unchanged.

compatibility.detail: The primitive retains overlays until authoritative reconciliation, supports rollback notices or failed same-key retry, drops answers already supplied by another actor, and sends Undo as a fresh inverse action. Existing web consumers are unchanged.

recovery.detail: Reloading discards client-only overlays; authoritative data remains unchanged.
